name: ALL THINGS BRIGHT
confidence: read from a public-domain score, unchecked
reviewNotes: The melody line read from the Timeless Truths score of All Things Bright and Beautiful (https://library.timelesstruths.org/music/All_Things_Bright_and_Beautiful/, its second score, “Bright and Beautiful”, William H. Monk, 1887, not ROYAL OAK), whose music it marks public domain; only the tune was taken, not the harmony. Its opening agrees with hymnary.org’s incipit 13465 31327 76513 (https://hymnary.org/tune/all_things_bright_monk). Hand fix: the score prints the refrain, then the verse ending “D.C. Refrain” with the refrain’s last bar marked Fine; the melody here writes that out as sung, refrain, verse, refrain, and the final refrain’s last bar ends on the doh with a crotchet rest where the verse’s upbeat stood. The verse turns to G major (the score changes its key signature there; the notes carry their F sharps). Monk’s dates (1823–1889) and the year 1887 are from https://hymnary.org/tune/all_things_bright_monk.
